messages.text: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer in Automotive, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

### 建議主軸
【推論】Based on current vault evidence, the best-supported Automotive opportunities for Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer are NG eCall / Hybrid eCall, automotive radar echo / ADAS radar test, C‑V2X/GNSS connectivity RF test, and emerging 5G NTN automotive connectivity test, because the passages directly tie these areas to automotive, regulatory or standards-driven testing, and R&S generator/analyzer or radio-test products [28][31][63][74][14].
### 推薦先賣
1. **NG eCall / Hybrid eCall compliance testing** — eCall has been mandatory for all new cars sold in the EU since 2018, 2G/3G circuit-switched networks are becoming obsolete, and NG eCall is stated to become obligatory from 2026-01-01, creating a standards-transition test need [72].  
2. **Automotive radar echo / ADAS radar object simulation** — R&S AREG800A is explicitly an Automotive Radar Echo Generator for dynamic artificial object generation, with radar bands including 76 GHz to 81 GHz and artificial-object distance, Doppler, HiL, OSI and synchronization capabilities documented [63][62][69].  
3. **C‑V2X / GNSS / automotive connectivity RF test** — Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF is described as a 5G automotive-grade platform supporting V2X and multi-band GNSS, while R&S sources list GNSS testing, LTE C‑V2X RF analyzer, and LTE C‑V2X / NR C‑V2X waveform capabilities [74][58][97][98].  
4. **5G NTN automotive connectivity / satellite-channel emulation** — the NTN signal-generator overview states 5G NTN-NR is gaining interest from automotive and identifies R&S SMW200A as a channel emulator / signal generator with long path delay, Doppler and dynamic fading capabilities, while R&S FSW is positioned for component testing and SAN transmitter measurement [14][13][16].  
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 / CMX-KA098 / CMX-KA099 | NG eCall over 4G/5G IMS、PSAP simulation、Hybrid eCall fallback validation | CMX500 with CMX-KA098 is stated usable for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions; CMX-KA098 completed PSAP scenarios according to EN 17240:2024+A1:2026; CMX-KA099 completed PSAP scenarios according to EN 18052:2025 [28][33] | Regulatory transition and standards testing are explicit: EN 17240:2024 covers IMS eCall over 4G LTE and 5G NR, and hybrid eCall requires fallback between NG eCall and classic CS eCall paths [72][31] | R&S and Qualcomm used CMX500 to verify Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF NG eCall functionality against EN 17240:2024, including voice/data transmission and PSAP simulation [7][10] | Press-release evidence is not a full certification report or test-case matrix, and software versions, test case IDs, network parameters and pass/fail details are not provided [70][71] |
| R&S AREG800A | Automotive radar echo generation, ADAS radar target/object simulation, radar HiL | Dynamic artificial object generation; hybrid echo concept uses analog stepped delay line below 17 m and fully digital implementation to 3000 m; digital mode is for FMCW radar with maximum generated distance 3000 m [62] | It is explicitly an Automotive Radar Echo Generator, supports 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar frontends, artificial-object distance coverage, individual Doppler shift, Ethernet/GPIB remote control, SCPI, HiL option, OSI and gPTP/NTP synchronization [63][69] | Doppler evidence includes ±500 km/h velocity setting range with AREG8-B9 and AREG8-B63, 0.001 km/h step size, Doppler frequency offset accuracy < 1 Hz measured in IF domain with a spectrum analyzer, and velocity accuracy < 0.05 km/h [65] | The vault states AREG800A is for automotive radar echo generation and is not an RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer, so it should be positioned as a radar-test opportunity adjacent to Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer rather than as a pure SG/SA product [5] |

| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|

The current vault does not contain a single ranked list of Automotive Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer opportunities, so any ordering above is an evidence-based synthesis rather than a cited ranking [28][63][14].

- AC input voltage range：100 V to 240 V；AC supply frequency：50 Hz to 60 Hz / 400 Hz。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › RF generator
Output level uncertainties 適用於 continuous wave，不適用於 overrange；wideband applications 可能產生 additional uncertainties。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作，驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 上 [[Next Generation eCall]]（NG eCall）的 implementation，並稱其符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 來源說 [[eCall]] 於 2015 年導入，且自 2018 年起成為歐盟境內所有新車銷售的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。
- [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 被描述為 5G automotive-grade platform，支援 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning、Vehicle-to-Everything（[[V2X]]）、multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱驗證流程使用 [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester，作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution。
- 來源稱測試模擬 [[PSAP]]，並驗證 implementation at both ends with the [[EN 17240]]:2024 standard。
- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。
- [[Juergen Meyer]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive 身分在新聞稿中引述，稱此次 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 建立 new benchmark。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing。
- 來源將合作定位為 mutually validating solutions、reducing effort、accelerating time to market for mutual customers。
- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

Hybrid eCall testing
[[Hybrid eCall testing]] 是驗證車輛 emergency call system 能在 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall transport paths 之間可靠運作與 fallback 的測試主題；[[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 將其連到 [[EN 18052]]:2025、[[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026、[[R&S CMX500]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KA09x]]。

Hybrid eCall testing › R&S solution context
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]：

- 測試方案基於 [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester。
- [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] updated eCall evaluation solution 支援 [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026 compliance。
- [[R&S CMX-KA099]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 18052]]:2025。
- [[R&S CMX-KA098]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[cetecom advanced]] conducted certification testing。

CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status › CEN TS 17240:2018
來源列出 CEN TS 17240:2018 的 IVS conformance test requirements，並區分 NR / LTE 欄位。可辨識內容包含：

- CTP 1.1.0.1：Conformance to ETSI TS 136 523 and ETSI TS 134 229 – 112-eCall IVS via IMS，標示 Not applicable，comment 為 covered with protocol test suite [[PCT5-KC625]]。
- CTP 1.1.0.2：Test for conformance to valid SIM/USIM – 112-eCall，標示 Available。
- CTP 1.1.1.1：Power on and self test，標示 Available*，comment 指出 manufacturer specific，PSAP 未定義 test point。
- Automatic trigger / manual trigger / test eCall / network registration / SIP Invite / IMS session establishment / MSD received / callback / clear-down 等測試列入表格。
- CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS：limited service condition 標示 Partly Available*；需要 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。
- CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS：Call-back answered by IVS in the event of abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 多個測試需要 HMI interaction、Ignition switched OFF、crash simulation、voice link simulation 或 IVS debugging tool，來源明示不完全由 KA09x software 控制。

- CMW500 / CMW-KA096 來源中，CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available，需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。

- CMW500 / CMW-KA096 來源中，CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS callback abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 3GPP TS 34.229-1 21.3 在既有 CMW500 來源中標示 Not available；CMX500 來源中 34.229-1 區段也可辨識 Not Available 標註。

NGeCall over LTE › 來源中的測試主題

- IVS manual eCall、automatic eCall、test eCall initiation。
- IMS eCall session establishment，包含 `urn:service:sos:ecall:automatic`、`urn:service:sos:ecall:manual`、`urn:service:test.sos.ecall` 等語彙。
- MSD transfer、MSD update、PSAP request、negative acknowledgement / missing acknowledgement 情境。
- Valid SIM/USIM、forbidden PLMN、limited service condition、roaming scenario。
- PSAP initiated callback、call clear-down、IVS initiated clear-down not allowed。
- Voice link established 與 audio interface verification。
- eCall only mode、T3444 / T3445、SRVCC handover to CS domain / UTRAN / GERAN。
- Time-Warping Conformance Test / No Time-Warping Conformance Test。
- CMX500 來源新增 5GS / NR 相關 3GPP TS 34.229-5 與 3GPP TS 38.523-1 測試脈絡。
- CMX500 來源新增 CEN EN 17240:2024 中 IPv4 / IPv6 MSD transfer、MSD version 3、additional data from Euro NCAP TB 040:2022 等項目。

NTN signal generator solutions › 來源中的 solution 分層
[[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] 將 NTN testing 分為四類：

- Component Testing。
- [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）Testing。
- End-to-end System Testing。

來源可讀內容主要展開前三者，尤其是 [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 channel emulation、[[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 與 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

NTN signal generator solutions › SAN testing
來源將 SAN testing 連到 [[3GPP TS 38.108]]、[[3GPP TS 38.181]]、[[3GPP TS 36.108]] 與 [[3GPP TS 36.181]]。在 signal generator 角度，[[R&S SMW200A]] 提供：

- Fixed Reference Channels（FRCs）。
- Test Models（TMs）。
- Fading Module。
- AWGN Module。
- static UE propagation models。
- TDL and moving propagation。
- SISO / MIMO。
- NB-IoT options：K119 / K115 / K143 / K146。
- NR options：K144 / K148 / K171。
- B14 / B15 + K71 moving propagation。

詳見 [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]]。

NTN signal generator solutions › Component testing
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 16，component testing 使用 DUT、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S FSW]]：

- [[R&S SMW200A]]：frequency up to 67 GHz，overrange 72 GHz；RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz，up to 4 GHz with [[R&S SMW-K555]]。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generation SW：LTE、Cellular IoT、5G NR R17/18（K171）、OFDM signal generation（K114）、custom digital modulation。
- [[R&S FSW]]：frequency up to 85 GHz，overrange 90 GHz；analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz。
- [[R&S FSW]] signal analysis SW：LTE、Cellular IoT、5G NR R17/18（K171）、OFDM signal analysis（K96）、Vector signal analysis（K70）。

answer.text:
### 建議主軸
【推論】Based on current vault evidence, the best-supported Automotive opportunities for Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer are NG eCall / Hybrid eCall, automotive radar echo / ADAS radar test, C‑V2X/GNSS connectivity RF test, and emerging 5G NTN automotive connectivity test, because the passages directly tie these areas to automotive, regulatory or standards-driven testing, and R&S generator/analyzer or radio-test products [28][31][63][74][14].
### 推薦先賣
1. **NG eCall / Hybrid eCall compliance testing** — eCall has been mandatory for all new cars sold in the EU since 2018, 2G/3G circuit-switched networks are becoming obsolete, and NG eCall is stated to become obligatory from 2026-01-01, creating a standards-transition test need [72].  
2. **Automotive radar echo / ADAS radar object simulation** — R&S AREG800A is explicitly an Automotive Radar Echo Generator for dynamic artificial object generation, with radar bands including 76 GHz to 81 GHz and artificial-object distance, Doppler, HiL, OSI and synchronization capabilities documented [63][62][69].  
3. **C‑V2X / GNSS / automotive connectivity RF test** — Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF is described as a 5G automotive-grade platform supporting V2X and multi-band GNSS, while R&S sources list GNSS testing, LTE C‑V2X RF analyzer, and LTE C‑V2X / NR C‑V2X waveform capabilities [74][58][97][98].  
4. **5G NTN automotive connectivity / satellite-channel emulation** — the NTN signal-generator overview states 5G NTN-NR is gaining interest from automotive and identifies R&S SMW200A as a channel emulator / signal generator with long path delay, Doppler and dynamic fading capabilities, while R&S FSW is positioned for component testing and SAN transmitter measurement [14][13][16].  
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 / CMX-KA098 / CMX-KA099 | NG eCall over 4G/5G IMS、PSAP simulation、Hybrid eCall fallback validation | CMX500 with CMX-KA098 is stated usable for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions; CMX-KA098 completed PSAP scenarios according to EN 17240:2024+A1:2026; CMX-KA099 completed PSAP scenarios according to EN 18052:2025 [28][33] | Regulatory transition and standards testing are explicit: EN 17240:2024 covers IMS eCall over 4G LTE and 5G NR, and hybrid eCall requires fallback between NG eCall and classic CS eCall paths [72][31] | R&S and Qualcomm used CMX500 to verify Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF NG eCall functionality against EN 17240:2024, including voice/data transmission and PSAP simulation [7][10] | Press-release evidence is not a full certification report or test-case matrix, and software versions, test case IDs, network parameters and pass/fail details are not provided [70][71] |
| R&S AREG800A | Automotive radar echo generation, ADAS radar target/object simulation, radar HiL | Dynamic artificial object generation; hybrid echo concept uses analog stepped delay line below 17 m and fully digital implementation to 3000 m; digital mode is for FMCW radar with maximum generated distance 3000 m [62] | It is explicitly an Automotive Radar Echo Generator, supports 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar frontends, artificial-object distance coverage, individual Doppler shift, Ethernet/GPIB remote control, SCPI, HiL option, OSI and gPTP/NTP synchronization [63][69] | Doppler evidence includes ±500 km/h velocity setting range with AREG8-B9 and AREG8-B63, 0.001 km/h step size, Doppler frequency offset accuracy < 1 Hz measured in IF domain with a spectrum analyzer, and velocity accuracy < 0.05 km/h [65] | The vault states AREG800A is for automotive radar echo generation and is not an RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer, so it should be positioned as a radar-test opportunity adjacent to Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer rather than as a pure SG/SA product [5] |
| R&S SMW200A / R&S FSW | 5G NTN automotive-interest connectivity, satellite-channel emulation, NTN component and SAN testing | SMW200A is the core signal generator / channel emulator for NTN; FSW is used for component testing and SAN transmitter measurement; SMW200A supports up to 67 GHz RF path A and 2 GHz RF modulation bandwidth in product specs [15][19][21] | NTN source says 5G NTN-NR is gaining interest from automotive and that SMW200A channel emulation supports long path delays, enhanced Doppler and customized dynamic fading [14] | E2E NTN testing supports satellite trajectory modelling, frequency-dependent atmospheric effects, up to 1073 ms delay and up to ±1 MHz Doppler with SMW firmware ≥ 5.30 and SMW-K820 customized dynamic fading [16] | The NTN source is a 2025 presentation, not a formal datasheet or price book, and recommended configurations are not directly quoteable without checking formal configuration guides and option availability [83] |
| R&S CMW100 / R&S CMP180 / R&S CMX500 GPRF-waveform ecosystem | C‑V2X, NR C‑V2X, GNSS and production RF test for connected-vehicle modules | CMW100 has LTE C‑V2X RF analyzer for E-UTRA band 47 TDD, 5855 MHz to 5925 MHz; CMP180 waveform options include GNSS, LTE C‑V2X and NR C‑V2X; CMX500 callbox GPRF libraries include GNSS, LTE C‑V2X and NR C‑V2X waveform libraries [97][98][99] | Automotive relevance is supported by Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF being described as an automotive-grade platform with V2X and precise multi-band GNSS navigation [74] | CMP180 provides RF generator/analyzer functions with simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing, two 8 × SnapN RF generator/analyzer connector benches, 400 MHz to 6000 MHz basic range and 6000 MHz to 8000 MHz extended range with CMP-K168 [55][57] | The vault does not directly state that CMP180 or CMX500 GPRF waveform packages are sold for automotive production lines, so the automotive link for these products is an application inference from V2X/GNSS capability and automotive platform context [74][98][99] |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| EU NG eCall migration and telematics validation | CMX500 with CMX-KA098 for EN 17240 NG eCall, plus CMX-KA099 where EN 18052 hybrid fallback is in scope [28][33] | Lead with 2026-01-01 NG eCall obligation, 4G/5G IMS eCall testing, PSAP simulation, voice/data transmission and hybrid fallback reliability [72][28][31] | Formal certification status, software versions, test-case IDs and full pass/fail matrix are not provided in the current vault [70][71] |
| ADAS radar target simulation and radar HiL | AREG800A with relevant AREG8 baseband, Doppler, frontend, HiL and synchronization options shown in the specifications [66][69] | Lead with dynamic artificial objects, 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar support, distance to 3000 m, individual Doppler, HiL, OSI and gPTP/NTP synchronization [62][69] | The evidence does not make AREG800A a general-purpose RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer; it is documented as automotive radar echo generation [5][63] |
| Automotive V2X/GNSS module RF and production test | CMW100 for LTE C‑V2X RF analyzer use cases, CMP180 for multiport RF generator/analyzer production test, and CMX500 GPRF waveform ecosystem where GNSS / LTE C‑V2X / NR C‑V2X waveform replay is needed [97][57][99] | Lead with V2X and multi-band GNSS as automotive platform requirements, then map to C‑V2X analyzer and waveform-generation evidence [74][97][98] | The passages do not provide a customer-specific automotive production deployment, exact BOM, price, or full test coverage for these combinations [60][83] |
| Automotive interest in NTN / satellite connectivity | SMW200A for NTN channel emulation and signal generation, FSW for NTN component and transmitter analysis [13][15] | Lead with automotive interest in 5G NTN-NR and SMW200A capabilities for long path delay, Doppler, dynamic fading and satellite trajectory-based fading files [14][16] | The source is a presentation-level overview and does not prove automotive design wins, full conformance coverage or quote-ready configurations [78][83] |
### 限制
The current vault does not contain a single ranked list of Automotive Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer opportunities, so any ordering above is an evidence-based synthesis rather than a cited ranking [28][63][14].  
The strongest direct Automotive evidence is for NG eCall and automotive radar, because the passages explicitly mention vehicle emergency-call regulation and an Automotive Radar Echo Generator, while C‑V2X/GNSS and NTN require combining automotive-platform or automotive-interest passages with product-capability passages [72][63][74][14].

來源將 E2E system testing 描述為對 UE、NTN payload、service link channel emulator 與 feeder link channel emulator 的 RF satellite link emulation。[[R&S SMW200A]] 需要 firmware version ≥ 5.30，並透過 B14 或 B15 搭配 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 支援：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。

- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。

- Resolution of setting：`0.001 Hz`。

R&S CMW100 K06 › LTE
- Standard：LTE FDD and TDD。
- LTE R&S®WinIQSIM2 option：R&S®CMW-KW500。
- LTE FDD RF analyzer option：R&S®CMW-KM500。
- LTE TDD RF analyzer option：R&S®CMW-KM550。
- LTE C-V2X RF analyzer option：R&S®CMW-KM570。
- LTE FDD eNodeB RF analyzer option：R&S®CMW-KN500。
- LTE TDD eNodeB RF analyzer option：R&S®CMW-KN550。
- LTE FDD RF analyzer bandwidth：1.4 MHz、3 MHz、5 MHz、10 MHz、15 MHz、20 MHz。
- LTE frequency measurement uncertainty：< 20 Hz + drift of timebase；LTE C-V2X 為 < 35 Hz + drift of timebase。
- LTE C-V2X RF analyzer frequency range：E-UTRA band 47 TDD，5855 MHz to 5925 MHz。

R&S CMP180 › Waveform 與 R&S WinIQSIM2 options
依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，CMP180 支援 waveform creator、standard-specific waveform playback 與 [[R&S VSE]] analysis options。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]] ordering information，software predefined waveform options 包括：

- Non-cellular waveforms for ARB generator pack 1：R&S CMP-PKV30，1212.3708.02。
- Cellular waveforms for ARB generator pack 1：R&S CMP-PKV40，1212.3714.02。
- GPRF waveforms：R&S CMP-KV210，1212.4427.02。
- GNSS waveforms：R&S CMP-KV220，1212.2330.02。
- NB-IoT waveforms：R&S CMP-KV250，1212.2347.02。
- LP-IoT waveforms, Zigbee / SigFox：R&S CMP-KV280，1212.2353.02。
- UWB production waveforms：R&S CMP-KV305，1212.4327.02。
- NG-UWB production waveforms：R&S CMP-KV306，1212.4704.02。
- Bluetooth waveforms / HDT Rel. 7.0：R&S CMP-KV310 / R&S CMP-KV317。
- WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be：R&S CMP-KV350 / K-V351 / K-V352。
- GSM、WCDMA、CDMA2000、LTE、LTE C-V2X、NR Rel. 15/16、NR Rel. 17、NR C-V2X。

[[R&S WinIQSIM2]] waveform options include waveform creator **R&S CMP-KW101** and AWGN / GNSS / NB-IoT / LP-IoT / Bluetooth / WLAN / GSM / WCDMA / CDMA2000 / LTE / NR waveform options.

CMX500_Callbox › 重點摘要
- High end-to-end throughput 部分稱 1024 DL QAM available in FR1、10.6 Gbps with 5CC SA verified、1CC FR1 + 8CC FR2、10 Gbps E2E testing，並列出 [[R&S CMX-KS610B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS637B]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KA100]]。
- Non-signaling / GPRF 部分稱 GPRF Generator signal types 包含 ARB、CW、Dual Tone、Replay `.wv` files、up to 4 GPRF Generator instances in parallel、ARB Sequencer，且標示 no license required；但 technology-specific R&S provided ARB files 與 WinIQSim2 waveforms 由 KWxxx licenses enable。
- GPRF / ARB file 部分列出 KW libraries：GNSS [[R&S CMX-KW220]]、BT [[R&S CMX-KW310]]、WLAN KW350/KW351/KW352/KW353、GSM KW420、WCDMA KW440、LTE KW500、NB-IoT KW250、LTE C-V2X KW570、NR Rel 15/16 KW601、NR Rel 17 KW602 + KW601、NR C-V2X KW670、AWGN KW120；另有 [[R&S CMX-KW101]] Create ARB on CMX，coming with CSW 9.10。
- IQ recorder 部分稱可 record up to 4 Gbyte to a file、save files as `.wv` for replay、使用 same IQ stream + RF parameters as signaling、2 per RFU、1 per IFU、FR1 specialist 可 8 instances in parallel。
- Standalone TX measurements 部分列出 [[R&S CMX-KM500]] LTE Measurements 與 [[R&S CMX-KM600]] NR FR1 Measurements, Single Carrier。
- QDART support 部分稱 CMX500 officially listed for 5G Sub-6 / 2G–4G，WLAN internally verified and currently in process to get listed in Qualcomm help files。
